Dissapointing cheese platter this time
Mar 2024 • Family
Visited on a Friday evening with some family on their last night in Hanoi. We sat inside but right at the back. The back bit doesn't really have much of a vibe, and you feel quite excluded from the main part of the restaurant.
The starters were all tasty, and we enjoyed two good bottles of wine and cocktails. All of the party enjoyed their meat selections for mains. As a non beef eater, I opted for a cheese board as a main, which I have done in the past here, but it was very disappointing this time. The portion size was much less than in the past. Instead of crackers, I got given 1 slice of bread, and the cheese was pretty average. It was frustrating as in the menu, they have a wine and cheese pairing page, so they stock a lot of good cheeses. It would be much better if they actually let you choose which 3 you would like on your platter and give you crackers!

reviews.review_text:
Lyn A
Houston, Texas109 contributions

Must try!
Sep 2023 • Couples
OMG - Do yourself a favor and check this place out. Even if you are staying in the Old Quarter it is a short Grab ride there and you will be very glad you got out of the chaos where you can enjoy a spectacular dinner. Very nice patio area, but if you want to sit inside with the a/c I highly recommend you book a table in advance. The service is off the charts. My (Mee) and Long took such amazing care of us. Now the food, WOW! I wanted to try all of the appetizers they had on the menu but settled for the bite sized empanadas, chimichurri deviled eggs and watermelon, feta and basil salad all which were delicious. Now for the meat - We split an Australian Ribeye and an Argentinian Picanha which we had never heard of before tonight. They were both exceptional, but the Picanha won in our book. Lovely wine selection, amazing sides and desserts. The owner Emilio also spent some time chatting with us which was super nice. He change the menu to keep things interesting and exciting. I highly recommend. Thanks for a wonderful night!
